description.fun: Shinx makes electricity by flexing the muscles in its forelegs, which sets its fur glowing. When it senses danger it flashes brightly enough to blind a predator, then runs while the foe can't see. It signals to other Shinx by shaking its shining tail tip, and even rolling over in its sleep makes a little charge. Its name blends shine with sphinx or lynx.
description.guide: Shinx is an Electric-type Pokémon resembling a lion cub or lynx kitten. It generates electricity by moving its muscles and makes its fur flash to blind predators before escaping. It evolves into Luxio and then Luxray.
description.tagline: A lion cub that flashes its fur to escape trouble.

description.fun: Luxio's claws carry enough current to make a foe faint from a light scratch, but among its own kind it's gentle: it chats by resting its forelegs on another's and sending rhythmic electric pulses, and it shares the spoils of a hunt fairly. Groups link tails to pool their power. Fittingly for National Pokédex No. 404, it has appeared on the Japanese Pokémon website's 404 error page.
description.guide: Luxio is the evolved form of Shinx, an Electric-type cat that lives in small groups. Its claws release strong electricity, which it also uses to communicate with others of its kind. It evolves into Luxray.
description.tagline: A sociable lynx that talks in electric pulses.

description.fun: Luxray sees through walls: when its eyes gleam gold it can spot prey hiding behind even thick ones, or track down its lost young. That X-ray vision drains a lot of electricity, so Luxray sleeps for long stretches to recharge. Its name joins lux, Latin for light, with X-ray, and its Japanese name, Rentorar, seems to come from Röntgen, another name for X-rays.
description.guide: Luxray is the final form of Shinx, an Electric-type lion-like Pokémon. It can see through solid objects, which helps it hunt and look after its young, but the ability uses so much electricity that it must sleep a lot. Luxray live in packs led by one male.
description.tagline: A lion with X-ray eyes that needs long naps afterwards.
